text: The 2021, 2022, and 2023 tree-cover loss events on this property are all supported by the evidence. The 2021 event (81.3 ha) and 2023 event (4.5 ha) meet the corroboration rule, as the JRC 2020 reference agrees on ≥50% of their areas (98% and 100%, respectively). The 2022 event (0.6 ha) also meets the rule (94% agreement), though it is very small. No events after 2020 are contradicted. The 2020 baseline shows 92.6% of the asset was forested, and all post-2020 losses were detected in areas confirmed as forest in 2020.
